name: Eliza Ellenstein
source:
Eliza Ellenstein was once a socialite herself in her youth until her family fell into disgrace.

Ten years prior to the events of the game, Eliza took the protagonist out of the Slum after a great fire left Magda orphaned. Eliza renamed her newly adopted daughter Magda, and raised her to be a refined young lady with the help of Duke Sakan.

Despite adopting her daughter for the purpose of re-establishing the Ellenstein family in the Senate, she loves and worries about her dearly.

[From [url=https://helix-waltz.fandom.com/wiki/Eliza_Ellenstein]Helix Waltz Wiki[/url]]
